field.label: Enable Mihomo
field.help: Enable or disable the Mihomo service.

field.label: Log Level
field.help: Select the logging level for Mihomo (debug, info, warning, error, silent).

field.label: API 绑定地址
field.help: Mihomo 外部控制 API 与内置面板的监听地址。127.0.0.1=仅本机；接口 IP=该网段可用（推荐，例如填 LAN 口 IP 后局域网 metacubexd 可直连）；0.0.0.0=全部接口含 WAN（IPv4+IPv6）。注意：非 127.0.0.1 时 /ui/ 静态页免密可达、API 走 Bearer 明文 HTTP；必须先配置 API 密钥。

field.label: API 端口
field.help: 外部控制 API 端口（1024-65535，默认 9090）。修改后 metacubexd 等客户端连接地址需同步更改。系统 WebGUI/SSH 端口及保留端口不可用。

field.label: Transport Mode
field.help: Proxy only keeps the socks listener local (127.0.0.1). Transparent proxy routes LAN traffic through the hev tunnel and the mihomo-transport PF anchor.

field.label: Expose Proxy to LAN
field.help: Disabled by default: the proxy listens on 127.0.0.1 only (socks 7890/7891) and LAN clients cannot use it. When enabled, the listener binds to the LAN side with secret-based authentication.

field.label: LAN Proxy Username
field.help: Username for LAN clients when the proxy is exposed. Only letters, digits and the characters . _ @ - are allowed (1-32 characters); invalid values fall back to mihomo.
